h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vasai Virar

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Vasai Virar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Vasai-Virar

c: Our factory is in Vasai East, so for buyers in Vasai-Virar we are a local manufacturer in the plainest sense. FunPlay Systems has been making play and fitness equipment here since 2002, in a 45,000 sq ft facility with 150+ employees. As an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Vasai-Virar, we work with housing societies, schools, colleges, gardens and the large new townships that have come up around Virar and Nalasopara.

Being this close means the equipment travels only a few kilometres, and our own installation team handles the work. Our sales team can suggest a set from photos and site measurements, then send a layout drawing with the clear space marked. The coastal monsoon here is very heavy, and our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are built with that in mind.

items.a: In Vasai East, Palghar district, Maharashtra. We design, mould and fabricate our equipment there, and supply the whole of India from this one facility.

items.q: Does your own team install in Vasai-Virar?
items.a: Yes. Our installation team handles local projects, using grouted or self-standing bases depending on the ground. We share care steps at handover.

items.q: How do the machines handle the coastal monsoon?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and seats and handles are roto-moulded, so heavy rain and sea air do not cause rust. Keep the base drained and wipe moving parts regularly.
